text:
alex chen: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to modernize the Optimize Toolkit sample for prefetch + batching + quant guidance. Old Go snippet used deprecated calls and the external gist is 404. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/462

maria ramos: thanks @alex. I can take the Go + JS snippets. For Go, do we surface ContinuousBatcher as the recommended pattern or show the older Batcher to avoid surprising users?

alex chen: Make ContinuousBatcher the primary example (recommended for low-latency). Add a one-line legacy note with Batcher equivalence. Also call out the "shortseq" quant profile recommendation for short chat messages.

samir patel: CI concern — the sample references an external gist for the main.go extract; swap to internal path so docs embed works: /examples/optimize/prefetch_go/main.go

lea-ux: tiny UX ask: include a 2-row mini table (legacy vs prefetch+continuous) showing tokens/sec and p95 latency so readers see impact quickly. Keep it minimal.

maria ramos: will add the table and a runnable microbench command: `go run ./examples/optimize/prefetch_go --profile shortseq --batch continuous`

maria ramos: proposed Go snippet:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
cb := optimize.NewContinuousBatcher(client, optimize.WithKVPrefetch())
res, err := cb.Generate(ctx, "Summarize: ...", optimize.WithQuantProfile("shortseq"))
if err != nil { return err }
fmt.Println(res.Text)
```

alex chen: looks good. Add a short fallback note: "On KV prefetch miss, requests fall back to the single-request path; expect ~1.8x latency."
samir patel: left a PR comment to include a unit test link and to ensure the internal path is used for CI snippet extraction.

ci-bot: docs-checks #462 started
ci-bot: docs-checks #462 passed — https://ci.redwood.internal/462/checks/9 :white_check_mark:

lea-ux: wording nit: change heading from "KV-prefetch" to "KV prefetch (optional)" so it doesn't read mandatory.

maria ramos: pushed update: internal path fixed, heading tweaked, perf mini-table added, and a 1-paragraph note about pinning quant profiles in Dedicated configs with a crosslink to /dedicated/configuring-quant-profiles.

alex chen: LGTM. approving. thanks y'all 🎉
samir patel: merging after CI finishes.

ci-bot: merge complete. PR #462 merged by samir patel at 1711204099
